review_type: Independent AI lesson-terminology consistency review, not human/native/device certification or legal/platform verification
reviewed_scope: Sections 2D, 2E, 2F and 3 as relevant music/course cross-checks

checks.result: Accepted: duration note names are distinguished from interval degrees.
Accepted: one consistent tempo is not a motionless hand.
Accepted: pitch direction is not inferred physical string location.
Accepted: short अन् and एक-इ-अन्-अ remain usable and preserve ASCII numbers.
Accepted: English evidence remains contextual, not untranslated instructional prose.
Accepted: stable original spelling when no verified established local title exists; identities require separate review.
Accepted: पट्टी/की, त्रिस्वरी कॉर्ड, इन्व्हर्जन and notation distinctions.
Accepted: frozen addendum independently reviewed separately; rhythm/list and finger/section contexts are now separate.
Accepted: युनिसन denotes identical pitch; English octave explanation does not give false etymology to सप्तक.
Accepted: बिंदू/बिंदूयुक्त, two large beats vs six counts, pitch whole/half steps distinct from durations.
Accepted: ता/ति-ति and 1-ता-कि keep usable subdivisions, swing on 1 and कि.
Section 5 accepted; conflicting older section D chop mapping requires reconciliation.
Accepted: मध्यवादन, कॅरोल, गीतगुंफण and dynamic meanings distinct from instrument.
